decisions.text: User requested cleanup and alignment before functional backlog. Codex coordinates MiniMax Desktop and Polar Desktop, both direct repository users. Default roles inferred from prior records; task ownership is explicit, not inferred from model name.

Current state lives only in docs/project-state.json; COORDINATION.md is generated. Product vision/spec are normative; archive is historical. PostgreSQL is the current backend, not SQLite. No live deployment, payment, database cleanup, or branch creation is part of ALIGN-01.

Canonical working checkout is C:\dev\compass at 36cf4ec, already matching origin/main. The attached OneDrive checkout was 29 commits behind; never use its state or restore its source over the canonical repo. Earlier backlog statements about global periods, signup throttling, migration verification and DST are superseded by upstream evidence.

Canonical upstream history already archived cluster/Polar documents; reuse docs/archive/clusters and docs/archive/handovers rather than duplicate them. Preserve upstream security/migration verification and existing deployment separation. A new 140-run encoding issue in the latest persistence smoke was found by the guard and repaired without changing its intended logic.

Both local database URLs were confirmed loopback PostgreSQL. CLI .env now targets the existing app .env.local database; app configuration and all other variables were preserved. Private original is in the Git-excluded recovery snapshot. No database writes, migrations or runtime fixture tests were executed.

Polar reviews remotely; Codex records confirmed report bytes through explicit remote-proxy claim/ack/review with report hash and attribution. MiniMax has local access and waits unassigned. Actor strings are cooperative, not authentication. User authorized ongoing desktop coordination messages. Initial changes_requested report was recorded by Codex through the legacy CLI, not executed by Polar.

User authorized PR-first integration, an isolated coordination follow-up and subsequent FIN-01 assignment. Remote integration branch is an explicit exception; canonical local checkout stays main with one writer. Main-only CI is intentional. ALIGN-02 addresses handoff evidence hashes and stale CI wording separately from approved ALIGN-01.
